qualified_workers: highly qualified workers with years of experience in welding composite materials and other materials with complex weldability properties.
team_description: are highly qualified welders and constructors who regularly undergo training and master modern technologies, document and certify each stage of work. A key role in the company is played by welders who can perform "mirror welding", as well as welding pipes from stainless steel, various alloys and structures. They flawlessly handle work on materials from carbon and alloy steel (including carbides) to difficult-to-weld metals, ensuring high quality of connections and assembly.
